assistant: Johnny Carson was the host of The Tonight Show Starring Johnny Carson, which was a talk show that aired from October 1, 1962 to May 22, 1992. The show was presented by Johnny Carson and narrated by Ed McMahon. It was produced by Fred de Cordova and Peter Lassally, and was filmed at NBC Studios in New York City from 1962 to 1972, and then at NBC Studios in Burbank, California from 1972 to 1992. The show was also known as The Tonight Show (franchise brand) and Johnny Carson (Antenna TV repeats). The genre of the show was talk and variety. The theme music for the show was composed by Paul Anka. The show had 30 seasons and 4,531 episodes. In an onscreen eulogy to Carson in 2005, David Letterman said that every talk show host owes his livelihood to Johnny Carson during his Tonight Show run.
[The End of Previous Conversation]

[The Start of Current Turn Question]
Who were the guest hosts on the tonight show?
[The End of Current Turn Question]

[The Start of Reference Answer]
Johnny Carson had guest hosts for entire weeks during Carson's vacations and other nights he had off. Many guest hosts were already large names in their own right, among them Frank Sinatra, Burt Reynolds and Don Rickles. Due to the frequent need for substitutes, starting in 1983 permanent guest hosts were hired in order to give the program more stability. The permanent guest hosts were Joan Rivers,  Garry Shandling and Jay Leno.
[The End of Reference Answer]
